data.name: Subra
data.gender_notes: Subra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Subra is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘subhra’, which means good, auspicious, and radiant. This name is considered to be a powerful and auspicious name for a boy in Hindu culture. The name Subra carries the meaning “Good, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Subra usually hope their child will grow to embody good, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Subra represents the divine qualities of good, auspiciousness, and radiance. It is believed to bring prosperity, success, and wisdom to the one who bears this name.
data.etymology: Subra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Subra total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Subra, being derived from the Sanskrit language, holds a deep cultural significance in Hindu tradition. Names in Hindu culture are believed to influence a person's life and destiny. The name Subra is considered possessing good and auspicious qualities, which makes a person born with this name popular and highly respected among their community. In Hindu mythology, Lord Subrahmanya is a significant deity associated with this name. He is the god of war, knowledge, and martial arts, and also the son of Lord Shiva. Honoring the deity through the name, various rituals and traditions follow in Hindu families.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Subra is believed to represent purity, knowledge, and devotion. The Sanskrit origin and relationship to Lord Subrahmanya add a layer of spiritual depth to the name. Families who name their child Subra often engage in spiritual practices and seek blessings from Lord Subrahmanya to protect and guide their child. The significance of the name extends beyond the personal level, reminding the individual of the larger spiritual perspectives and connections to the deity and the divine principles of knowledge, purity, and devotion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Subra: Radiance of the Divine Self. A name signifying the inner light and spiritual brilliance of an individual.
